reviewers.summary: i18n plumbing correct: dictionaries match the frozen export verbatim with identical key sets (parity 74/74), never-translate labels isolated in CALC_LABELS, context/toggle sound, pure core enforced by tests. 9/9 tests pass.

findings.summary: createTranslator's returned t was typed (key: string) => string, so mistyped keys at downstream call sites would compile and silently render the raw key.
findings.recommendation: Derive a key union so call sites get compile-time key checking; fallback-to-key stays as the intentional runtime behavior.

reviewers.summary: openspec validate i18n --strict: PASS. All four owned IDs (FR-I18N-01/02/03, TC-I18N-01) implemented + covered; dictionaries trace verbatim to DESIGN §11 / export STR (nested gridQual correctly flattened to qexact/qclose/qpoor); no heavy i18n dep; no scope drift (provider not mounted, toggle not placed in header = deferred to FR-SHELL-03/app-shell). 9/9 tests pass.

findings.summary: The toggle's group aria-label="Language" was a hardcoded screen-reader-facing string not resolved through t(), staying English in the UA locale. The canonical STR export has no key for it.
findings.recommendation: Add a dictionary key and source the aria-label via t().

reviewers.summary: Clean against the pure-client threat model: no package.json/lockfile change (no i18n library — TC-I18N-01), no localStorage/cookie/IndexedDB/navigator/fetch/analytics (locale is in-memory useState — BC-PRIVACY-01), no server/api (TC-DATA-01), no dangerouslySetInnerHTML/eval; dictionary strings render as auto-escaped JSX text; t() keys are static developer-controlled literals (no reflected-injection sink).
